# Hand-authored, not vendor-derived — see tests/fixtures/NOTES.md. The vendored corpus has
# zero live cases of one scripted variable's value being another @variable reference (verified
# across all 53 scripted_variables/*.txt files in vendor/), so the resolver's recursive
# resolution has nothing real to run against. This gives it a three-level chain, ending in a
# genuine numeric literal, resolved in an order that doesn't match declaration order — the
# resolver must not assume declaration order is dependency order.

@chain_top = @chain_middle
@chain_middle = @chain_base
@chain_base = 1000
